source.name: MotoGP.com: BLACKANDLIGHT - new year, new colours for Pertamina Enduro VR46 (byline: Pertamina Enduro VR46 Racing Team)
source.quote: Pertamina Enduro VR46 Racing Team have revealed their 2026 colours!
source.note: 2026 livery launch, Rome, 14 Jan 2026. Pertamina (Enduro) is the team's title sponsor and names the team; on the team's own Sponsors page (vr46racingteam.it/sponsors) it stands alone under 'TITLE SPONSOR' with the link www.pertaminalubricants.com.

source.name: 12B Sports: 12B SPORTS Named Main Sponsor of VR46 Racing Team for the 2026 MotoGP Season
source.quote: today announced its appointment as Main Sponsor of Pertamina Enduro VR46 Racing Team for the 2026 MotoGP World Championship season
source.note: Same announcement distributed by GlobeNewswire on 30 May 2026 (thestar.com). The team's Sponsors page also lists 12B Sports under 'MAIN SPONSORS' with the link www.12bsports.com.

summary: 2026 Pertamina Enduro VR46 Racing Team (Fabio Di Giannantonio, Franco Morbidelli). Pertamina (Enduro lubricants) is the title sponsor and gives the team its name (front). The team's own Sponsors page (vr46racingteam.it/sponsors, opened 3 Oct 2026) lists the full 2026 partner roster in three tiers, all recorded here with the page's own category named in each source note: Main sponsors 12B Sports (itself announced as main sponsor for the 2026 season via GlobeNewswire, 30 May 2026), Comoli Ferrari and Monster Energy; Official sponsors 958 Santero, Barracuda, Cupra, Dainese, Ercos, Fassi, Hero, Lino Sonego, Oakley, Refrigiwear and Tsunami Nutrition; Technical sponsors Aerre, Akrapovic, Beta, Bischoff Scheck, D.I.D, Ducati (bike supplier), Iveco, Kappa, Michelin (MotoGP's spec tyre supplier), MotoCorse, RCB, Reabilita, SportTravel, Sprint Filter, Velocifero, Vmoto and WRS. The page shows partners as logo cards with a link, not by name in its text; the quote in each source is the sponsor's website address as printed on the page.
